race.comment: CAFE AU LAIT (12) will be looking to rebound from a pair of plain recent efforts in Sydney, after making a promising start to the campaign. The peaks are there and she should get a good look from a favourable draw. HE'S TRU BLUE (7) wasn't beaten far first-up at Eagle Farm and is sure to have come on from that, though Thompson will need to be on top of his game from the tricky draw. HEADHUNTER (18) continues to leave himself with too much to do but can cause a late scare if the pace is genuine. CUTEPI (4) a last start BM78 second at this track and a soft-track Class 3 win two back stack up well for this. In the mix.
